definitions.explanation: An item of cultural property designated by the Japanese government as having exceptional historical or artistic value, the highest classification of cultural property in Japan.

examples.japanese: この{城|しろ}は{国宝|こくほう}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: This castle has been designated as a national treasure.

examples.japanese: {国宝|こくほう}の{絵画|かいが}を{見|み}に{美術館|びじゅつかん}へ{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the museum to see the national treasure paintings.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}には{千|せん}を{超|こ}える{国宝|こくほう}がある。
examples.english: Japan has more than a thousand national treasures.

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
・{重要|じゅうよう}{文化財|ぶんかざい} (important cultural property)
・{世界|せかい}{遺産|いさん} (world heritage)

CATEGORIES:
{国宝|こくほう} includes buildings, paintings, sculptures, crafts, calligraphy, and historical documents that are of exceptional importance to Japanese cultural heritage.
